positionally), so ordering is expressible and the corpus sees it. The retirement
is a property of the MODEL, so it holds on every tree measured against that
model. M09 is not deleted, not re-seeded and not excused: it still runs and is
still scored in the `ordering` class row. What it stops doing is deciding
whether the instrument works.
